اهتلكتم (form VIII)
# اِهْتَلَكْتُمْ (ihtalaktum) /ih.ta.lak.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# اُهْتُلِكْتُمْ (uhtuliktum) /uh.tu.lik.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
